response.sql: WITH valid AS (SELECT event_status, amount - spent AS leftover FROM budget WHERE amount IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(leftover) AS overall_avg FROM valid), by_status AS (SELECT event_status, AVG(leftover) AS avg_leftover FROM valid GROUP BY event_status) SELECT b.event_status, b.avg_leftover AS average, b.avg_leftover - o.overall_avg AS difference_from_overall FROM by_status b CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL;
